name: @catenahq/templates
description: Catena template catalog: one JSON source per template plus its compose file, rendered into Portainer App Templates (templates.json v3) and the machine catalog (catalog.json). Consumed by catenahq/ops (vendored tarball) and by Portainer directly (App Templates URL).

scripts.verify: uv run build/render.py && git diff --exit-code blueprints templates.json catalog.json index.html
